vars.coverSub: A 370 URL technical plan, a 24 asset authority system, five new builder blogs, and the release controls that turn content into qualified demand.
vars.agreementTitle: What the paid pilot actually asked for

agreementItems.body: Discovery, audit, keyword and content strategy, architecture, priorities and implementation planning.
One pillar page, two supporting articles, technical SEO and WordPress implementation support.
35 hours at $30 per hour. Phase 2 social, downloadable and webinar production remained a future scope, not part of the paid pilot.

vars.stateTitle: One system: crawlability, answers, proof and conversion

stateCard.title: Nothing new is public yet
stateCard.body: The new blogs and collateral are staged for private review. Existing public content stays untouched until a named owner approves facts, images, metadata, links, schema and release timing.

vars.stateTakeaway: Current public builder hub remains unchanged.
vars.evidenceTitle: Where site health is leaking authority

evidenceCard.title: Correct signals before scaling content
evidenceCard.body: Fix the homepage “Stategic” typo across meta, Open Graph and schema. Reduce the AI services page from four H1s to one. Review nofollow page by page. Repair sitemap eligibility. Re-test the builder hub mobile critical path after media and script work.

vars.evidenceTakeaway: These affect interpretation, discovery, rendering or distribution.
vars.priorityTitle: The builder hub has a performance problem, not a cosmetic one
vars.priorityBody: Re-measure after image sizing, format, preload, font, third-party script and critical CSS work. A single sample is a diagnostic baseline, not a permanent score.
vars.contractTitle: The page contract: ten layers, one accountable owner
vars.workstreamsTitle: Five separate blogs, each owning one verified gap

workstreamItems.title: When to hire + how to judge
Technical repair sprint
workstreamItems.body: typo, H1s, nofollow, sitemap, hub speed

vars.rolloutTitle: Repair first. Release in waves. Learn before scaling.

rolloutItems.label: Days 1 to 14

rolloutItems.label: Days 15 to 30
rolloutItems.body: Release first two + verify events and indexing

vars.rolloutTakeaway: 12-month scale: expand only where Search Console, client questions and sales feedback justify the next asset.
